intro.note: screen images at the recordings' sizes: scale them into the boxes like the recordings, then crossfade into the live UI in place

windows: alpha 0 exactly at driver and passenger; opaque everywhere else
composite: background, recordings scaled into the boxes, then the frame on top (or the frame first and the recordings over it: same pixels)

approach.why: Muse Image 1.0 drew convincing straight-on cockpits, but neither plate gave a clean 16:9 driver window: cockpit-1's screens cover 62% of the width (driver 16:9 fit ~1040 px wide on the canvas, 80% of this layout) and cockpit-2's wide screen is 1.47:1 with the steering wheel crossing its lower-left corner. Legibility first, so the frame is drawn here around the largest boxes that fit.
